method.fog: HazeGen from Wang et al., CVPR 2025 (arXiv 2503.19262), IRControlNet stage1.pt over Stable Diffusion 2.1, inference w=0.85, 50 sampler steps, prompt 'hazy, foggy, misty, obscure, smoggy.'
method.motion: normalised linear motion PSF, cv2.filter2D with BORDER_REPLICATE
method.low: gamma attenuation + exposure gain + Poisson shot noise + Gaussian read noise
method.composite: HazeGen fog (when available) then low-light then motion blur, in physical order

annotation_policy: Every family preserves scene geometry, so the source bounding boxes are inherited unchanged. Fog was verified empirically (defect-box SSIM 0.708 vs 0.614 for size-matched random boxes). The physical operators were verified translation-equivariant.
calibrated_recall: With a YOLO 11 trained on clean data only (box recall, IoU>=0.5, conf 0.25): clean 65.9%, motion 38.5%, low-light 18.7%, composite 22.5%.
